product_metadata.title: Sauder Storage Cabinet, Ebony Ash finish
features: Tip restraint safety strap included because we care about you and your family
description: Organize and contain your household clutter with this storage cabinet from the Sauder select collection. Behind its large double doors is a spacious hidden storage area that contains six adjustable shelves. These six shelves adapt to all your needs With their ability to adjust and conform to different heights to give you room for any small, large or misshaped items you may have. It also features a full upper shelf for additional space. Find ample amount of room to store and stash away anything from your collection of books, organizing bins and board games to blankets, crafting supplies or even pantry items. It has space for it all! This tall cabinet adds simple design and elegance that is sure to stand out in any room of your home – living room, dining room, office, or even the bedroom! Finished in ebony ash, this good-looking storage cabinet gives your home The style and functionality you've been wanting.
